title: Resort-Style Tropical Escape w/ Pool, Spa & Cabana
description:
Welcome to Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz — a lush, private tropical retreat featuring a resort-style backyard, mature palms and lush hedges for total privacy, a heated pool, hot tub, cabanas, and expansive spaces designed for gathering and connection.

 The space 
My name is Maxwell, and I am your host.

Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz is our first family-owned and operated vacation home, created with intention, heart, and countless hours of care. My five older siblings and I purchased and completely reimagined this property together — renovating, redesigning, and restoring it with a single vision: to create a place where families could gather, reconnect, and feel truly at home.

Our late parents grew up in the city of Santa Cruz, Pampanga, in the tropical islands of the Philippines. From very humble beginnings, they built a life centered around family, generosity, and welcoming others — always making sure that anyone who entered their home left with a full heart (and usually a full belly and a to-go plate).

In 1962, our father enlisted in the U.S. Navy and served for decades, moving our family across multiple states before retiring honorably in Bremerton, Washington. Together, our parents raised six children and later welcomed seven grandchildren with an eighth on the way, always leading by example through love, hospitality, and togetherness.

They dreamed of one day creating a home like this for their family — a place filled with warmth, laughter, food, and connection. Sadly, they did not live to see that dream fully realized, nor did our beloved sister Marilou, whose encouragement and unwavering belief in this vision gave me the confidence to lead and bring it to life.

What began as a family dream also became the foundation for a thoughtfully designed hospitality experience — applying the same care, creativity, and attention to detail that now guides our growing portfolio of vacation homes.

Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz is our way of honoring them — not as a memorial, but as a living expression of their values. A home meant to be shared. A space meant to bring people closer. A reminder that the most important luxury in life is time spent together.

For video walkthroughs and behind-the-scenes looks at our vacation homes, you can find us on Insta at @maximize.stays.
________________________________________

🌴 Your Private Resort-Style Backyard

The backyard is the heart of Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz — intentionally designed so everyone can relax together, without competing for space, no matter the season.

Whether you’re hosting a pool day, celebrating a special occasion, or winding down under the stars, this space was thoughtfully planned to support large groups with comfort, flow, and flexibility.

Resort-Style Lounging & Seating
• Ten ultra-plush, oversized daybeds designed for all-day comfort
• Two private cabanas offering shaded, relaxed lounging
• Multiple outdoor sofas in both the VIP cabana and covered patio
• Comfortable lounging for up to 16 guests at once, with ample space for everyone to relax, recline, or stretch out poolside

All-Season Comfort
• Covered patio equipped with wired heat lamps for cooler months
• Hot tub tucked beneath a pergola-style gazebo for shade and privacy
• Ceiling fans, misters, and ambient string lighting for year-round enjoyment

Dining, Games & Gathering
• Outdoor picnic-style dining table ideal for shared meals
• Additional lounge chairs thoughtfully placed throughout the yard
• Turf area with classic yard games for casual fun
• Outdoor propane fire pit surrounded by Adirondack chairs — perfect for evening conversations
• Outdoor TVs, BBQ grill, and flat-top griddle for effortless entertaining

A True Sense of Privacy
Once inside the backyard, the outside world fades away. Over the past three years, the palm trees and Hollywood hedges surrounding the property have matured into a lush, green privacy wall around the backyard.

From the pool and cabana areas, it feels as though you’ve been transported to a private tropical retreat — many guests are surprised to realize they’re still in a residential neighborhood.

This natural screening enhances the sense of calm, seclusion, and escape, allowing you to fully unwind without feeling overlooked or exposed.

The result is a true resort-style experience — thoughtfully designed for comfort, connection, and ease from morning sun to late-night fireside conversations.
________________________________________

🏡 Designed for Gathering

Every detail of this home was thoughtfully chosen to support group stays while still offering comfort and ease:
• Spacious layout ideal for families and larger groups
• Perfect for group trips, celebrations, and milestone weekends — with space to gather, relax, and make memories together
• Multiple seating zones throughout the home and backyard — perfect for group conversations or more intimate one-on-one moments
• Two living rooms for gathering, relaxing, or spreading out
• Dedicated workspace with monitor for remote work
• High-speed WiFi throughout the home
• Smart TVs and streaming services for downtime

Whether you’re hosting a family dinner, enjoying movie night, or easing into a slow morning, the home is designed to support every pace of vacation.
________________________________________

🛏️ Bedrooms & Comfort

• Six private bedrooms
• Premium Simply Modern hybrid gel memory foam mattresses
• High-thread-count Pima cotton sheets
• Ceiling fans, smart TVs, full-length mirrors, and ample storage
• Three additional self-inflating queen air mattresses available

Comfort, rest, and flexibility are priorities here — especially for longer stays or multi-family trips.
________________________________________

🍽️ Fully Equipped Kitchen & Dining

The kitchen is stocked for real use — not just display.
• High-quality cookware and tools
• Coffee bar with two coffee pots, Keurig, grinder, and essentials
• Ample dishware for adults and children
• Two refrigerators (one in the kitchen, one in the garage)
• Plenty of space for cooking, serving, and gathering

Perfect for shared meals, celebrations, and everything in between.
________________________________________

📍 Prime Location & Nearby Wedding Venues

Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz offers the best of both worlds — a private, resort-style escape that still provides easy access to the Valley’s most popular destinations.

Easy Access
• ✈️ Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport: ~25 minutes
• 🏙️ Downtown Phoenix: ~25 minutes
• 🌵 Old Town Scottsdale: ~30 minutes

💍 Popular Nearby Wedding Venues

This home is especially well-suited for wedding groups and family stays, with several sought-after East Valley venues just minutes away:
• Superstition Manor – ~9 minutes (4.7 miles east)
• Stonebridge Manor – ~13 minutes
• The View at 55th Place – ~12 minutes

With generous space, privacy, and a layout designed for groups, Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz is an ideal home base for wedding weekends, rehearsal dinners, and multi-day celebrations.

Whether you’re here for a celebration or a relaxing getaway, the location makes it easy to arrive, settle in, and fully enjoy your time together.

⚾ Spring Training Friendly Location

Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz is a great home base for Spring Training season, offering convenient access to several Cactus League stadiums across the Valley.

Popular nearby fields include those in Mesa, Tempe, Scottsdale, and Phoenix — all within approximately 10–30 minutes, depending on the venue.

After a day at the ballpark, return to your private resort-style backyard to unwind, relax, and gather together.
________________________________________

🧺 Practical Comforts

• Professional laundering of all linens and towels
• Large laundry room with washer, dryer, and supplies
• Cleaning and sanitization between every stay
• Extra towels, storage, and thoughtful amenities throughout
________________________________________

🌺 A Note From Our Family

Paradise at Villa Santa Cruz is more than a vacation rental — it’s a family dream brought to life.

We’ve poured our hearts into creating a space where guests feel cared for, comfortable, and welcome. Whether you’re celebrating something special or simply slowing down together, we hope your stay here becomes a favorite memory.

If there’s anything we can do to support your experience, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

On behalf of our family — welcome, relax, and enjoy your stay in Paradise.

Warmly,
Maxwell
